पंजाब में गुलजार सिंह ने AAP सरकार के मंत्री हरपाल सिंह चीमा से नशे पर सवाल पूछा तो उन्हें डराया-धमकाया गया। उन पर इतना दबाव डाला गया कि उन्होंने अपनी जान दे दी। ये गुलजार की मौत से पहले का वीडियो है, जिसमें वे AAP सरकार के मंत्री को अपनी मौत का जिम्मेदार ठहरा रहे हैं। आम आदमी पार्टी ने पंजाब को नशे के दलदल में धकेल दिया है। ड्रग्स माफिया सरकार चला रहे हैं और उनके खिलाफ आवाज उठाने वालों को इतना प्रताड़ित किया जाता है कि वो जान देने को मजबूर हो जाते हैं। इस अपराध के लिए पंजाब की जनता आम आदमी पार्टी को कभी माफ़ नहीं करेगी। Video

न्यू राजेंद्र नगर, बूथ/पार्ट नंबर 46 के Draft Electoral Roll में 746 वोटर थे और Raghav Chadha जी का नाम नहीं था। Raghav Chadha जी खुद दावा कर रहे थे कि वे पंजाब के वोटर हैं और वहीं दोबारा वोट बनवाएंगे। चुनाव आयोग ने भी Draft Electoral Roll फ्रीज़ कर दिया था। ऐसे में SIR के दौरान Raghav Chadha जी का नाम दिल्ली के इसी बूथ की वोटर लिस्ट में कैसे जुड़ गया? यह नया वोट किस प्रक्रिया के तहत बनाया गया? चुनाव आयोग जवाब दे। — @Saurabh_MLAgk, दिल्ली प्रदेश अध्यक्ष, AAP Video

एक व्यक्ति ने मंत्री के सामने अपनी समस्या रखी और उसके शिकायत रखने के तुरंत बाद परिवार की शिकायत पर सभी लोगों को गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया। लेकिन जिस व्यक्ति का पहला वीडियो सामने आया, उसमें उसने कहीं भी किसी मंत्री का नाम नहीं लिया था। जब उसने ज़हर खा लिया, तो उसे तुरंत अस्पताल ले जाने के बजाय कथित तौर पर मंत्री का नाम लेकर वीडियो बनवाने का दबाव डाला गया और कहा गया कि अगर वह वीडियो नहीं बनाएगा, तो उसे अस्पताल नहीं ले जाया जाएगा। क्या बीजेपी, कांग्रेस और अकाली दल की राजनीति इतनी गिर चुकी है कि अब लाशों पर भी राजनीति की जा रही है? -@anuragdhanda, National Media In-charge, AAP Video

31 अगस्त के ड्राफ्ट रोल में दिल्ली के राजेंद्र नगर के एक बूथ पर 746 वोट थे और Raghav Chadha जी का नाम नहीं था। अब उसी बूथ पर 747 वोट हैं और Raghav Chadha जी का नाम जुड़ा हुआ है। अगर बिना किसी डॉक्यूमेंटेशन और तय प्रक्रिया का पालन किए चुनाव आयोग बैकएंड से किसी का नाम SIR में जोड़ या हटा सकता है, तो यह लोकतंत्र की खुली लूट है। दिल्ली चुनाव आयोग बताए कि 31 अगस्त के बाद किस प्रक्रिया के तहत Raghav Chadha जी का नाम वोटर लिस्ट में जोड़ा गया? इस पूरे मामले की जांच होनी चाहिए। अगर तय प्रक्रिया का पालन किए बिना उनका नाम जोड़ा गया है, तो उनका नाम वोटर लिस्ट से हटाया जाए और पूरी प्रक्रिया का पालन किया जाए। -@anuragdhanda, National Media In-charge, AAP Video

In a crucial step to help prevent a nuclear accident, the Zaporizhzhya NPP was re-connected to the electrical grid today following successful power line repairs carried out during an IAEA-brokered localized ceasefire, Director General @rafaelmgrossi says. The restoration of off-site power after an outage lasting almost three weeks means the ZNPP can once again access external electricity to cool its reactors and spent fuel ponds, as well as for other essential nuclear safety and security functions. It is a much-needed development also as the ZNPP was facing a possible station blackout, with diminishing diesel fuel reserves available to operate emergency generators which have been providing backup power since its sole remaining power line - Ferosplavna-1 - was lost due to military activity north of the Dnipro River on 20 August. Under the protection of the 7th localized ceasefire negotiated by DG Grossi during the conflict, Ukrainian technicians earlier today completed three days of repairs, paving the way for Ferosplavna-1 to be re-connected to the ZNPP. DG Grossi thanks both the Russian Federation and Ukraine for engaging with the Agency in agreeing on the ceasefire and enabling off-site power to be restored. The IAEA will continue its indispensable work to help ensure nuclear safety and security during the conflict, DG Grossi adds. IAEA - International Atomic Energy Agency ⚛️ (@iaeaorg) Another IAEA-brokered localized ceasefire has taken effect to enable power line repairs necessary for the restoration of off-site power to the Zaporizhzhya NPP after a long outage, DG @rafaelmgrossi announced today. Due to military activity on the northern side of the Dnipro River, the plant lost the connection to its sole remaining power line - the 330 kilovolt Ferosplavna-1 - on 20 August. Since then, the ZNPP has depended on emergency diesel generators to cool its six reactors and spent fuel pools. The plant is now running low on diesel fuel reserves and faces a possible station blackout within days unless off-site power is restored or more fuel reserves can be transported to the site, located in an active war zone. Under the temporary ceasefire around the damaged power line, Ukrainian technicians will begin power line repairs later today following demining of the area, DG Grossi said, adding that both sides had been engaging constructively with the IAEA for the sake of nuclear safety and security. An IAEA team will monitor the repairs during the ceasefire, the 7th that DG Grossi has negotiated as part of efforts to help prevent a nuclear accident during the conflict. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/iaeaorg/status/2096135832998387745#m

দীর্ঘ ১২ বছর পর আবারও ইংল্যান্ড ক্রিকেটের সঙ্গে যুক্ত হচ্ছেন সাবেক তারকা ব্যাটসম্যান কেভিন পিটারসেন। আগামী বছরের ওয়ানডে বিশ্বকাপকে সামনে রেখে তাকে সাদা বলের দলের ‘স্পেশালিস্ট মেন্টর’ হিসেবে নিয়োগ দিয়েছে ইংল্যান্ড অ্যান্ড ওয়েলস ক্রিকেট বোর্ড (ইসিবি)। দক্ষিণ আফ্রিকায় জন্ম ও বেড়ে ওঠা পিটারসেনের স্থানীয় কন্ডিশন সম্পর্কে অভিজ্ঞতাকেই বিশেষ গুরুত্ব দিচ্ছে ইংল্যান্ড। দক্ষিণ আফ্রিকা, জিম্বাবুয়ে ও নামিবিয়ায় অনুষ্ঠেয় বিশ্বকাপের প্রস্তুতিতে তার জ্ঞান কাজে লাগাতে চায় দলটি। চলতি মাসের শেষ দিকে শ্রীলঙ্কার বিপক্ষে সিরিজ দিয়ে ব্রেন্ডন ম্যাককালামের কোচিং স্টাফে দায়িত্ব শুরু করবেন পিটারসেন। অস্ট্রেলিয়া ও দক্ষিণ আফ্রিকা সফরসহ বিশ্বকাপ পর্যন্ত দলের সঙ্গে কাজ করার কথা রয়েছে তার। ২০১৪ সালে বিতর্কিতভাবে ইংল্যান্ডের আন্তর্জাতিক ক্যারিয়ারের ইতি ঘটেছিল পিটারসেনের। ইসিবির সঙ্গে তখনকার সম্পর্কের অবনতি এতটাই চরমে পৌঁছেছিল যে দুই পক্ষের মধ্যে ‘আস্থার সংকটের’ কথাও প্রকাশ্যে এসেছিল। তবে সময়ের সঙ্গে সেই দূরত্ব মুছে গেছে। এবার ইংল্যান্ডের তরুণ ব্যাটসম্যানদের সঙ্গে নিজের অভিজ্ঞতা ভাগাভাগি করার সুযোগ পাচ্ছেন সাবেক এই বিধ্বংসী ব্যাটার। পিটারসেনকে কোচিং স্টাফে পেয়ে উচ্ছ্বসিত প্রধান কোচ ম্যাককালামও। #football #SportsNews #Sports #somoytv

ساعت یازده شب بود که صدای کوبیدن بر دروازه‌ی حویلی، سکوت و تاریکی را شکافت. صدایی خشک و پیاپی؛ طوری که انگار می‌خواست چوب دروازه را از جا بکند. همه از خواب پریدند. زن خانه چادرش را روی سر انداخت و بچه‌ها، هراسان، روی بسترهای‌شان نشستند. کریم که هنوز خستگی سفر در تنش بود، دیرتر از همه از جا بلند شد. چند لحظه پشت پنجره ایستاد و از لای پرده به دروازه نگاه کرد. زیر نور کم‌جان چراغ کوچه، چند مرد مسلح دیده می‌شد؛ با ریش‌های بلند و دستارهای تیره. یک موتر نیز چند متر آن‌سوتر، با چراغ‌های خاموش ایستاده بود. یکی از مردان بر دروازه می‌کوبید و با لحنی آمرانه فریاد می‌زد: «دروازه را واز کنین.» کریم برای چند لحظه مات ماند. ذهنش میان چندین احتمال می‌چرخید. سه سال پیش، از ترس همین لحظه، از کابل به پاکستان گریخته بود؛ اما آن‌جا هم پناهی برایش نمانده بود. پولیس پاکستان یک هفته پیش او را همراه با صدها مهاجر دیگر بازداشت و از مرز اخراج کرده بود. حالا در خانه‌ی خودش، درست همان چیزی روبه‌رویش ایستاده بود که سال‌ها از آن گریخته بود. نمی‌دانست چگونه فهمیده‌اند که برگشته است. شاید نامش در میان اطلاعات مربوط به بازگشت‌کنندگان ثبت شده بود. شاید کسی در محل از بازگشت او خبر داده بود. شاید سوابق کاری گذشته‌اش دوباره مورد توجه قرار گرفته بود. هیچ‌کدام را نمی‌توانست با اطمینان بگوید. فقط می‌دانست که فرصتی برای فکر کردن باقی نمانده است. نگاهی به حویلی تاریک انداخت. دیوار پشتی خانه به کوچه‌ای باریک می‌رسید که از آن‌جا می‌شد به سمت خانه‌ی برادرزاده‌اش رفت. اما آیا فرصت چنین کاری وجود داشت؟ و اگر می‌رفت، زن و کودکانش چه می‌شدند؟ اگر می‌ماند، چه سرنوشتی در انتظار خودش بود؟ کوبیدن در دوباره بلند شد؛ این‌بار همراه با فریادی خشن‌تر: «اگه دروازه واز نشوه، خودمان واز می‌کنیم.» زن با چشمانی پر از اشک دست مردش را گرفت و با تضرع گفت: «نرو... من می‌روم و می‌گویم کسی خانه نیست... یا می‌گویم مریض استی.» کریم اما می‌دانست که در چنین لحظه‌ای هیچ پاسخ ساده‌ای وجود ندارد. نمی‌دانست مأموران چه اطلاعاتی دارند و با چه هدفی آمده‌اند. نفس عمیقی کشید، دست همسرش را فشرد و به‌سوی دروازه رفت. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/260588

This is poetry!!!! Nayib Bukele (@nayibbukele) Now, what DO these results tell us? 1. They tell us that 1,198 students in 171 ordinary Salvadoran public schools participating in this program were independently assessed using an internationally comparable instrument. And their results in reading, mathematics and science were comparable with the average results of students in Germany and Sweden. That is a fact, supported by an internationally recognized OECD assessment and reported by the World Bank. 2. They tell us that achieving those levels of performance in Salvadoran public schools is POSSIBLE. This is perhaps the most important finding. For decades, we have been told that transforming education takes generations. That poverty determines educational outcomes. That our public schools simply cannot compete with schools in developed countries. Yet here we have Salvadoran children, attending Salvadoran public schools, taught by Salvadoran teachers and supported by AI tutors, inside our existing public education system, obtaining results comparable with students in some of the world’s most developed countries. Does that prove that every Salvadoran student is already performing at that level? Of course not. But it proves something enormously important: There is nothing inherent about being Salvadoran, attending a public school, coming from a lower-income family, or living in a developing country that prevents a child from reaching those levels. 3. It tells us that the conditions associated with these results appear to be replicable. Imagine that the explanation were that we selected 171 elite private schools, filled them with the country’s wealthiest children, and then announced their scores. That would tell us almost nothing about whether the model could work nationally. But that’s not what happened. These are ordinary public schools. The advantages associated with participation in the pilot: better tools, connectivity, infrastructure, teacher support, technology and a different educational model, are precisely the things the Government can reproduce. That doesn’t guarantee the same results when we scale. But it gives us a very good reason to try. 4. It tells us that expanding the program is worth doing. A pilot is not supposed to prove that something already works everywhere. If it did, it wouldn’t be a pilot. A pilot asks a much simpler question: “Does this approach show enough promise under real-world conditions that we should expand it and test whether the results can be reproduced at a much larger scale?” The answer from these results is clearly yes. The World Bank itself described the results as promising and encouraging evidence ahead of the expansion of the reform. 5. The real test begins NOW. Going from 171 schools to more than 1,000 schools is much harder. Going from 1,000 schools to every public school in El Salvador will be harder still. Scaling introduces new problems. Some schools have weaker infrastructure. Some have worse connectivity. Some teachers will adapt faster than others. Some communities face greater social and economic challenges. And implementation quality can decline as a program becomes larger. All of that is true. And that is exactly why we are scaling progressively. The next question is not whether 171 schools can do it. We now know they can. The question is whether 1,000 can. Then whether several thousand can. And ultimately whether an entire national public education system can. That is what we intend to find out. 6. And yes, the future national PISA results that will be published in 2029 will matter enormously. Those will tell us something different. PISA for Schools tells us what is happening in the schools participating in this reform. National PISA will tell us what is happening across the country. Those are different questions, and serious people should not confuse them. 2/2🧵👇🏼 — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/nayibbukele/status/2097088816117088299#m

Nayib Bukele (@nayibbukele) A few days ago, I shared the World Bank’s summary of the results of the PISA for Schools assessment conducted in 171 Salvadoran public schools participating in our education pilot. Since then, I have seen some legitimate questions about what these results mean, as well as some claims about what they supposedly don’t mean. So let’s be very precise. First, what we NEVER claimed: 1. We never claimed these results represent the national average. They don’t. This was not the national PISA assessment. It was PISA for Schools, conducted specifically in the 171 public schools participating in our pilot program. That is precisely why my original post said: “These are the results of our pilot program, which includes AI tutors and has been running in 171 public schools for just over a year.” A pilot is, by definition, not the entire country. 2. We never claimed that these 171 schools were a statistically representative sample of every school in El Salvador. They weren’t selected randomly from all Salvadoran schools. They were selected to participate in the pilot because they were schools where the program could initially be implemented more easily: they had certain basic infrastructure and connectivity requirements, and school communities capable and willing to implement a new educational model. That creates a selection effect, and it should be acknowledged. But there is an important distinction here. These schools were NOT selected because their students had exceptional academic results. They were not our “best schools.” Not even close. We didn’t search the country for the highest-performing schools or students and then test them. They are normal Salvadoran public schools, urban and rural, in different parts of the country, serving ordinary Salvadoran families. And the characteristics that made implementation easier: connectivity, infrastructure, trained teachers and willingness to adopt the program, are also things that can be replicated in other schools. They are not innate characteristics of the students. We can install connectivity. We can improve infrastructure. We can train teachers. We can provide the same technology. We can deploy the same educational tools. In fact, that is exactly what we are doing. 3. These results also do NOT prove that AI tutors, by themselves, caused the improvement, although we believe they are a MAJOR part of these results. Our pilot is broader than that. It includes changes in teaching, support for teachers and principals, educational materials, monitoring and evaluation, technology, and AI tools, among other interventions. Our AI tutors and learning platforms are being developed with @grok, @Kira_Learning, and support from I Hate Flying Bugs. And the broader transformation of our education system is being supported by the @WorldBankGroup, @AgendaCAF, and @el_BID. All of these interventions can also affect student motivation and engagement. But that distinction matters: if students become more motivated BECAUSE of the program, that is not necessarily a flaw in the program or an explanation that somehow invalidates the results. It may be one of the ways the program works. The same applies to teachers. For example, the implementation of the AI tutors, including the requirement for teachers to log in and out of the system, coincided with teacher attendance in these schools increasing from 76% to 97%. If the program causes teachers to attend school more consistently, and that in turn helps students learn more, that is not an advantage that disappears when we scale the program. It is potentially part of the intervention itself. Of course, to scientifically isolate the causal effect of AI tutors, teacher attendance, student motivation, technology, training, or any other individual component would require a different experimental design. Regarded as the birthplace of Arabica coffee, Ethiopia is one of the world's major coffee-producing countries. As demand for coffee among Chinese consumers has grown in recent years, China has become an increasingly important market for Ethiopian coffee. #BRICS2026 China became the third-largest buyer of Ethiopian coffee during the 2025/26 fiscal year, which ended on July 7, Shafi Umer, deputy director general of the Ethiopian Coffee and Tea Authority (ECTA), told Xinhua News Agency in an interview. Ethiopia exported 47,836 tonnes of coffee to China during the fiscal year, generating $347 million in revenue, according to ECTA data, marking increases in both volume and value. China has further deepened its cooperation with African countries by expanding its zero-tariff treatment to cover all 53 African countries with which it has diplomatic ties. Starting July 20, China also allows eligible coffee beans from these countries to enter its market. The convenience brought by the new policies is bringing more African coffee to Chinese cups. The message was clear: this is not simply another update for the Chinese market. Huawei wants the entire world to pay attention to what it is building. That message resonates with me personally. This summer, I traveled across China, visiting more than 12 cities, attending one of the world’s most important semiconductor events in Shanghai, and witnessing firsthand how Huawei technology is transforming communities—from rural villages to major cities. It gave me a front-row seat to the remarkable pace of technological development taking place across China. Huawei’s latest breakthrough is amazing to see—and an exciting development for the entire global technology industry. #Huawei #Kirin Video

The disaster began near Langtang Lirung, one of the Himalayas’ most formidable peaks. Right behind the northern side of the peak there was a big, unnamed, hanging glacier receding for the past 100 years. The rock beneath this glacier had been also weakening for years — frequent melting & re-freezing of water creeping into crevices kept weakening the rock. 3. On 26 August, the weakened bedrock gave way & dragged down the hanging glacier with it. This glacier fell about 5,000ft, bringing ice, water & rock, the weight of which has been reckoned to be about 50mn tonnes. That impact formed 2 temporary landslide lakes, where water rapidly accumulated. 4. When these dams failed, a massive GLOF was unleashed. Scientists estimate the flow reached speeds of up to 150 kmph. The torrent carried huge boulders, ice, steel & concrete debris. Early speculation had suggested an earthquake may have triggered the collapse. But now it is widely understood that it was the impact of this falling debris that had generated a 5.2 magnitude quake. 5. The region's vulnerability came into focus in 2015 with the 7.8 magnitude Nepal earthquake. The southwest side of Langtang Lirung had seen a big piece fall off, which had weakened the mountain. As recently as July last year, there was a GLOF incident in the same place that had taken away the Nepal-China friendship bridge & 4% of Nepal’s hydroelectric potential. 6. Should China & Nepal have continued building infrastructure for trade, transit, pilgrim travel, or even plan a Lhasa-Kathmandu railway line, 95% of which was to be built through tunnels? রাজধানীর হাজারীবাগে একটি বাড়ির ছাদে বজ্রপাতে রিয়াজ (১৮) নামে এক যুবকের মৃ'ত্যু হয়েছে। এই ঘটনায় তার ৪ বছর বয়সি ভাতিজি আন্তরা আহত হয়েছে। সোমবার (৭ সেপ্টেম্বর) বেলা পৌনে ৩টার দিকে হাজারীবাগ বউবাজার এলাকার চারতলা একটি বাড়ির ছাদে এ ঘটনা ঘটে। মুমূর্ষু অবস্থায় স্বজনরা তাকে ঢাকা মেডিকেল কলেজ হাসপাতালের জরুরি বিভাগে নিয়ে আসলে চিকিৎসক বিকেল পৌনে ৪টার দিকে মৃ'ত ঘোষণা করেন। হাসপাতালে মৃ'ত রিয়াজের আত্মীয় মো. সুমন জানান, বৃষ্টিতে ভিজতে ছাদে গিয়েছিলেন রিয়াজ ও তার ভাতিজি অন্তরা। হঠাৎ বজ্রপাতে দুজন অচেতন হয়ে পরে। দ্রুত তাদের স্থানীয় হাসপাতালে নিয়ে যাওয়া হয়। সেখান থেকে রিয়াজকে ঢাকা মেডিকেলে নিয়ে আসলে চিকিৎসক মৃ'ত ঘোষণা করেন। অন্তরা শিকদার মেডিকেলে চিকিৎসাধীন আছে। তিনি আরও জানান, রিয়াজের গ্রামের বাড়ি লক্ষ্মীপুরের সদর উপজেলার চররমণী গ্রামে। তিনি হাজারীবাগের বউবাজারের ওই বাসায় থাকতেন এবং একটি জুতার কারখানায় কাজ করতেন। ঢাকা মেডিকেল পুলিশ ক্যাম্পের ইনচার্জ (পরিদর্শক) মো. হাবিবুর রহমান মৃ'ত্যু'র বিষয়টি নিশ্চিত করে জানান, ময়নাতদন্তের জন্য ম'র'দে'হ হাসপাতালের মর্গে রাখা হয়েছে। হাজারীবাগ থানা পুলিশ বিষয়টি তদন্ত করছে। #Dhaka #LightningStrike #WeatherAlert #somoytv

দেশের চলমান জ্বালানি সংকট বর্তমান সরকারের সৃষ্টি নয় এবং সরকার আন্তরিকভাবে এ সংকট সমাধানের চেষ্টা করছে বলে জামায়াতে ইসলামীর আমির ও সংসদের বিরোধীদলীয় নেতা ডা. শফিকুর রহমানের দেওয়া বক্তব্যকে স্বাগত জানিয়েছেন প্রধানমন্ত্রীর রাজনৈতিক সহকারী মো. রাশেদ খাঁন। সোমবার (৭ সেপ্টেম্বর) জাতীয় সংসদে ৬৮ বিধিতে জরুরি জনগুরুত্বপূর্ণ বিষয়ে মনোযোগ আকর্ষণের নোটিশের ওপর বক্তব্য দিতে গিয়ে জ্বালানি ও গ্যাস সংকটের কারণে বিদ্যুৎ উৎপাদন ব্যাহত, শিল্পকারখানায় ক্ষতি এবং জাতীয় অর্থনীতিতে সম্ভাব্য বিপর্যয় নিয়ে কথা বলেন ডা. শফিকুর রহমান। দেশের চলমান জ্বালানি সংকট বর্তমান সরকারের সৃষ্টি নয় বলে মন্তব্য করেন তিনি। তবে তিনি বলেন, সরকার সংকট সমাধানে আন্তরিকভাবে চেষ্টা করলেও জনগণের দুর্ভোগ দিন দিন কমছে না, বরং বাড়ছে। তার বক্তব্যের পর প্রতিক্রিয়ায় রাশেদ খান বলেন, জ্বালানি সমস্যা এই সরকারের সৃষ্টি নয় এবং সরকার আন্তরিকভাবে সংকট সমাধানের চেষ্টা করছে—বিরোধীদলীয় নেতার এমন বক্তব্য ইতিবাচক। এ জন্য তিনি ডা. শফিকুর রহমানকে ধন্যবাদ জানান। রাশেদ খান বলেন, ‘আমি বিরোধীদলীয় নেতার শুভবুদ্ধির উদয় হওয়ার জন্য ধন্যবাদ জানাই।’ তিনি বলেন, এতদিন বিএনপি জ্বালানি সংকটের পেছনে যেসব কারণের কথা বলে আসছে, জামায়াতের আমিরও এখন একই ধরনের বক্তব্য দিয়েছেন। তাহলে এতদিন জনগণকে কেন উসকানি দেওয়া হয়েছে, সেই প্রশ্ন তোলেন তিনি। জাতীয় সংকটকে পুঁজি করে এক লাখ লিটার তেল খরচ করে লংমার্চ করা হয়েছে বলেও দাবি করেন রাশেদ খান। তার মতে, ওই কর্মসূচিতে দলীয় নেতাকর্মীদের বাইরে সাধারণ মানুষের তেমন সম্পৃক্ততা দেখা যায়নি। তিনি বলেন, ‘লংমার্চে কি সাধারণ মানুষ সাড়া দিয়েছে? তাদের নেতাকর্মীর বাইরে সাধারণ মানুষের কোনো সম্পৃক্ততা এই লংমার্চে পরিলক্ষিত হয়নি।’ রাশেদ খান আরও বলেন, সম্ভবত জামায়াতের আমিরও বুঝতে পেরেছেন যে সাধারণ মানুষ বাস্তবতা উপলব্ধি করেছে। তার দাবি, জ্বালানি সংকট বর্তমান সরকারের তৈরি নয়, বরং সরকার এটি উত্তরাধিকার সূত্রে পেয়েছে। #RashedKhan #ShafikurRahman #EnergyCrisis #somoytv

নবায়নযোগ্য সৌরবিদ্যুৎ উৎপাদনের প্ল্যান্ট স্থাপনের যন্ত্রপাতি আমদানিতে শুল্ক-কর ছাড় এবং নিম্নস্তরের সিগারেটের ন্যূনতম মূল্য বৃদ্ধিসহ বেশ কয়েকটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ প্রস্তাবে অনুমোদন দিয়েছে মন্ত্রিসভায়। সোমবার (৭ সেপ্টেম্বর) জাতীয় সংসদ ভবনের কেবিনেট কক্ষে প্রধানমন্ত্রী তারেক রহমানের সভাপতিত্বে মন্ত্রিসভার ২০তম বৈঠক অনুষ্ঠিত হয়। বৈঠকে নবায়নযোগ্য সৌরশক্তি উৎপাদনের প্ল্যান্ট স্থাপনের যন্ত্রপাতি ও যন্ত্রাংশ আমদানিতে আগামী ৬ মাসের (১৮০ দিন) জন্য বিশেষ শুল্ক-কর ছাড় দেওয়া হয়েছে। প্রজ্ঞাপন জারির তারিখ থেকে ১ শতাংশের অতিরিক্ত কাস্টমস ডিউটিসহ সমুদয় রেগুলেটরি ডিউটি, সম্পূরক শুল্ক, ভ্যাট, আগাম কর এবং অগ্রিম আয়কর থেকে অব্যাহতি পাওয়া যাবে। সরকারের লক্ষ্য, দ্রুততম সময়ে নবায়নযোগ্য শক্তির মাধ্যমে বিদ্যুৎ ঘাটতি কমিয়ে জনদুর্ভোগ লাঘব করা এবং শিল্প উৎপাদন ও বিনিয়োগে ইতিবাচক পরিবেশ তৈরি করা। এছাড়া নিম্নস্তরের সিগারেটের অবৈধ বাণিজ্য ও রাজস্ব ঘাটতি কমাতে এর দাম বাড়ানোর প্রস্তাব অনুমোদন করেছে মন্ত্রিসভা। মূল্য সংযোজন কর ও সম্পূরক শুল্ক আইন, ২০১২-এর আওতায় নিম্নস্তরের সিগারেটের সর্বোচ্চ খুচরামূল্য (প্রতি ১০ শলাকা) ‘৬২ টাকা বা তদূর্ধ্ব’-এর পরিবর্তে ‘৬৫ টাকা বা তদূর্ধ্ব’ পুনর্নির্ধারণ করা হয়েছে। পাশাপাশি এদিন মন্ত্রিসভা বৈঠকে বিদেশি বিনিয়োগ বাড়াতে বাংলাদেশ ও হংকংয়ের মধ্যে ‘প্রমোশন অ্যান্ড প্রটেকশন অব ইনভেস্টমেন্ট অ্যাগ্রিমেন্ট’ শীর্ষক একটি চুক্তি স্বাক্ষরের প্রস্তাব অনুমোদিত হয়েছে। ১০ বছর মেয়াদি এই চুক্তির ফলে বাংলাদেশে শিল্পায়ন, কর্মসংস্থান, প্রযুক্তি ও জ্ঞান স্থানান্তর ত্বরান্বিত হবে। চুক্তিতে স্বাক্ষরের ৩ বছর পর উভয় পক্ষের সম্মতিতে এটি সংশোধনের বিধান রাখা হয়েছে। #SolarPower #TaxPolicy #CigarettePrices #somoytv

An interesting, topical & relevant discussion. But I’m afraid Gen Shukla is not only ahead of his time but also appears an incurable optimist - both in his book on Civil-Military Fusion & in his hope for the dawn of a “National Security Epoch” in India. Our wheels are jammed by a glue that consists of complacency, incomprehension & sloth in equal parts. While his wish for reincarnation of a K Subramaniam may well come true & there may be an Alex Karp lurking amongst our Gen-Z, one doubts if enough energy or interest can be generated to create a technological “Manhattan moment” for the military. The KRC & the Group of Ministers reports were rendered in 1999 & 2001; the A&N Command will celebrate its silver jubilee next month; CDS & DMA are 7 years old. But Theatre Commands remain a mirage. Finally, an example of our priorities. Our aerospace sector is in crisis - projects from basic/advanced trainers, to Tejas to AMCA & Kaveri engine seem to be floundering. And yet, when an Experimental Test Pilot & Fighter Combat Leader with invaluable experience in the aviation world becomes available, where does he find a place? In a temple trust! "In this regard, those who made the decision in Washington and Oslo to deploy these systems in Norway should not be surprised that, as part of Russia's response measures, the locations of U.S. missile systems and their control centers, as well as the infrastructure that supports them, are becoming the subject of particular attention from the strategic deterrence forces of the Russian Federation," the Foreign Ministry statement said.

In a fragmented world, the @IAEAorg is more indispensable than ever. Addressed the Board of Governors this morning on our impartial and expert work as part of some of the most sensitive and consequential international efforts of our time. In Syria, we have achieved a historic breakthrough. Having received the necessary access and information, the Agency has been able to clarify and resolve its questions concerning the outstanding safeguards issues related to Syria’s past nuclear activities. I welcome Syria’s transparency and cooperation. At ZNPP, the nuclear safety situation remains delicate. Following persistent IAEA efforts, a seventh localized ceasefire took hold this weekend, allowing demining and repair work to begin on a vital power line. Both Russia and Ukraine engaged constructively to make this possible, showing that practical steps can be taken even in extremely difficult circumstances to improve nuclear safety. I again call for maximum military restraint around all nuclear facilities and their staff. In Iran, the Agency has neither received information on the status of declared nuclear material or facilities nor had access to conduct in-field verification activities during this reporting period. Our lack of information and inability to conduct verification is a serious proliferation concern that needs to be rectified with the utmost urgency. A return to diplomacy and negotiations is imperative: they are the only way to achieve long-term assurance that Iran will not acquire nuclear weapons. The Republic of Korea has formally notified the IAEA of its intention to start consultations on an arrangement for nuclear-powered submarines, reiterating its commitment to fulfill its obligations under the NPT, its safeguards agreement and Additional Protocol. MESSAGE FROM THE CHAIRMAN OF THE CARIBBEAN COMMUNITY HON. PHILIP J. PIERRE, PRIME MINISTER OF SAINT LUCIA IN OBSERVANCE OF CARICOM-AFRICA DAY, 7 SEPTEMBER 2026 On behalf of the Caribbean Community (CARICOM), I extend warm greetings to the Governments and people of the African Union, CARICOM and the wider African Diaspora as we mark the fifth anniversary of CARICOM–Africa Day. This historic milestone reaffirms our shared commitment to a unified vision for a forward-looking partnership and strategic cooperation for our two regions. Since Heads of State and Government moved to establish this annual observance at the First CARICOM-Africa Summit in 2021, our bonds have strengthened significantly. The signing of the Memorandum of Understanding between the CARICOM and the African Union (AU) Secretariats on 26 September 2024 marked a pivotal step in deepening inter-secretariat cooperation . Concurrently, our Member States have expanded bilateral engagement through partnerships with institutions such as Afreximbank, whose Caribbean office continues to catalyse financing for infrastructure, small businesses, and trade. We have also advanced joint initiatives in health services and air connectivity to unlock commercial trade, tourism, and direct people-to-people exchanges. As we observe the Second International Decade for People of African Descent and uphold the United Nations Declaration on the Rights of People of African Descent, we honour the resilience of our ancestors and pay tribute to those lost to the atrocities of the Transatlantic Slave Trade. CARICOM continues to play a significant leadership role in the global campaign for reparatory justice, working hand in hand with continental partners, who have embraced and advanced this critical cause for repair and diasporic unity. In the face of compounded global challenges, including climate-induced natural disasters and geopolitical instability, our regions must leverage a collective voice to advocate for sustainable development, climate resilience, and the interests of vulnerable states. CARICOM remains steadfast in its commitment to regional solidarity, sovereignty, and self-determination. The people of the Caribbean Community are vital constituents of the African Union’s Sixth Region, and our deepening alliance, as a model of South-South cooperation, seeks to deliver practical, measurable benefits, opening new horizons for youth, expanding markets for local enterprises, and reinforcing our collective resilience. On behalf of the Caribbean Community, I extend best wishes for the continued well-being, progress, and prosperity of the African Union and the peoples of Africa as we fortify the fraternal ties that bind us.

1. Nearly 2 weeks since the disaster in Nepal, the death toll has climbed to over 1,300. Now, fresh clues offer an insight into what could have caused the flash floods. #CutTheClutterlooks at how a bedrock collapse took a hanging glacier down, & creating 2 landslide lakes that eventually broke, how warnings have been ignored, & why “climate compensation” clamour doesn’t stand. 2. The disaster began near Langtang Lirung, one of the Himalayas’ most formidable peaks. Right behind the northern side of the peak there was a big, unnamed, hanging glacier receding for the past 100 years. The rock beneath this glacier had been also weakening for years — frequent melting & re-freezing of water creeping into crevices kept weakening the rock. 3. On 26 August, the weakened bedrock gave way & dragged down the hanging glacier with it. This glacier fell about 5,000ft, bringing ice, water & rock, the weight of which has been reckoned to be about 50mn tonnes. Consistent with reports that Saudi Aramco’s Jizan refinery was targeted in a strike earlier today, NASA’s Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS) detected three thermal anomalies in the facility’s storage and distribution area. The three heat signatures were detected at approximately 4:40 a.m. UTC. FIRMS detects thermal anomalies from satellite observations, but the data does not by itself establish what caused them. Today’s incident would mark the second reported attack on the Jizan facility in just over a month. The refinery, which has a capacity of approximately 400,000 barrels per day, was also targeted by the Houthis in August. The repeated targeting comes amid a broader escalation between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis, with attacks increasingly affecting Saudi energy infrastructure and shipping in the Red Sea. The Houthis have not yet publicly claimed responsibility for today’s strike, according to the Financial Times. OSINTdefender (@sentdefender) The Financial Times is reporting that Saudi Aramco’s Jizan refinery has been attacked for the second time in just over a month. The extent of the damage is still being assessed, and there are currently no reports of casualties. The attack comes amid a significant escalation between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-backed Houthis since July. Saudi airstrikes on Houthi positions and the Houthis’ subsequent attacks on Saudi territory have increasingly focused on energy infrastructure and maritime traffic. The Houthis declared a blockade of Saudi linked shipping in the Red Sea in July and have claimed attacks against Saudi oil tankers, military targets and energy facilities. On August 9, the group claimed an attack on the Jizan refinery, where a fire was reported and later extinguished. The escalation has also spread into Yemen, with Saudi backed forces and the Houthis engaged in increasingly heavy fighting along the western coast. Recent clashes have raised concerns that the fragile 2022 ceasefire could be collapsing altogether. A second apparent strike on Jizan would mark another step in the widening Houthi-Saudi confrontation, particularly as the group continues to target Saudi energy infrastructure and shipping. বগুড়া শান্তাহারে ঢাকাগামী ‘কুড়িগ্রাম এক্সপ্রেস’ ট্রেনের লাগেজ ভ্যানের একটি বগি লাইনচ্যুত হয়েছে। এতে উত্তরবঙ্গের সঙ্গে রেল যোগাযোগ বন্ধ রয়েছে। সোমবার (৭ সেপ্টেম্বর) সন্ধ্যা ৭টার দিকে সান্তাহার স্টেশন এলাকায় এ ঘটনা ঘটে। জানা যায়, সন্ধ্যা ৭টার দিকে বগুড়ার সান্তাহার রেলওয়ে জংশন স্টেশন এলাকায় কুড়িগ্রাম থেকে ছেড়ে আসা ঢাকাগামী কুড়িগ্রাম আন্তঃনগর এক্সপ্রেস ট্রেনের লাগেজ ভ্যানের একটি বগি লাইনচ্যুত হয়। এতে সারা দেশের সঙ্গে ট্রেন চলাচল বন্ধ রয়েছে। লাইনচ্যুত বগিটি উদ্ধার করে ট্রেন চলাচল স্বাভাবিক করার চেষ্টা চলছে। এ বিষয়ে সান্তাহার রেলওয়ে স্টেশন মাস্টার খাতিজা খানম জানান, কুড়িগ্রাম এক্সপ্রেসের লাগেজ ভ্যানের একটি বগি লাইনচ্যুত হয়েছে। বগিটি লাইনচ্যুত হওয়ার পর যশোর-পার্বতীপুর রুটে ট্রেন চলাচল সাময়িকভাবে বন্ধ রয়েছে। এতে ওই রুটে চলাচলকারী ট্রেনগুলোকে সাময়িকভাবে থামিয়ে রাখা হয়েছে। লাইন মেরামতের কাজ চলছে। মেরামত কাজ শেষ হলে ওই রুটে ট্রেন চলাচল আবারও স্বাভাবিক হবে। #Bogura #KurigramExpress #RailwayService #somoytv

A fruitful discussion on ‘Neural Tube Defects and the Critical Role of Folic Acid’ was chaired by Dr. Jitendra Singh, Union MoS (Independent Charge), Science & Technology, and co-chaired by Dr. Gobardhan Das, Member, NITI Aayog, in New Delhi. A team of eminent neurologists from the Neurological Society of India, led by Dr. Sanjay Behari, Senior Neurologist & Director, SCTIMST, Thiruvananthapuram, shared key insights on the critical role of adequate folic acid intake in reducing the risk of neural tube defects and supporting healthy neurological development of the foetus, particularly during the early stages of pregnancy. The discussion underscored the need to translate scientific evidence into effective public-health policy and action towards healthier mothers and children. @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp @dasgobardhan

Dr. Ashok Kumar Lahiri, Vice Chairperson, NITI Aayog, delivered the inaugural address at Shodhotsav 2026, the Annual Research Festival of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi, on 7 September 2026. He highlighted the critical role of research, innovation and entrepreneurship in transforming knowledge into policies, products and solutions that can strengthen institutions and improve lives. He emphasised that this role extends beyond STEM to the social sciences and humanities, where research can address critical challenges in education, healthcare, welfare delivery and public behaviour. Drawing on examples such as Aadhaar, he underscored how ideas can evolve into transformative instruments for governance and public service delivery. He also highlighted the need to strengthen India’s R&D ecosystem through greater investment, institutional capacity, industry linkages and funding pipelines. 33,872 स्टार्टअप्ससह महाराष्ट्र देशात अव्वल, मुंबई जागतिक भांडवलाचे केंद्र केंद्रीय गृह व सहकार मंत्री अमित शाह यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आणि मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या प्रमुख उपस्थितीत आज गोवा येथे भारत सरकारच्या गृह मंत्रालयांतर्गत आंतरराज्यीय परिषद सचिवालयाद्वारे आयोजित पश्चिम विभागीय परिषदेची 28 वी बैठक पार पडली. 2026-2027 या चालू आर्थिक वर्षाच्या पहिल्या तिमाहीत भारताने 7.8% इतका विकास दर नोंदवल्याची बाब नमूद करत केंद्रीय गृह व सहकार मंत्री अमित शाह म्हणाले, जागतिक पातळीवरील घडामोडी आणि अस्थिरतेच्या पार्श्वभूमीवर देशाच्या अर्थव्यवस्थेने इतका विकास दर साध्य करणे ही आपल्या सर्वांसाठी अभिमानाची बाब आहे. अनेक दृष्टीने पश्चिम क्षेत्र हे देशासाठी अत्यंत महत्त्वाचे असून, हे देशातील सर्वात मोठे आर्थिक, औद्योगिक आणि वित्तीय केंद्र आहे. महाराष्ट्राच्या आर्थिक आणि औद्योगिक विकासाचा उल्लेख करत केंद्रीय मंत्री अमित शाह यांनी 33,872 स्टार्टअप्ससह महाराष्ट्र देशात प्रथम क्रमांकावर असल्याचे नमूद केले. देशाची वित्तीय राजधानी मुंबई जागतिक भांडवलाचे महत्त्वाचे केंद्र म्हणून वेगाने उदयास येत आहे. तसेच, महाराष्ट्राने प्राथमिक कृषी पतसंस्थांच्या (PACS) संगणकीकरणाचे 98% काम पूर्ण करून उल्लेखनीय प्रगती साधली असल्याचे केंद्रीय मंत्री अमित शाह यांनी अधोरेखित केले. मागील 12 वर्षांत पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांनी संविधानात नमूद केलेली सहकार्यात्मक संघराज्यवादाची संकल्पना प्रत्यक्षात आणण्यासाठी कार्य केल्याचे केंद्रीय मंत्री अमित शाह यांनी नमूद केले. नरेंद्र मोदी पंतप्रधान झाल्यानंतर विभागीय परिषदांच्या बैठकांमध्ये लक्षणीय वाढ झाली असल्याचे सांगत केंद्रीय मंत्री अमित शाह म्हणाले, 2004 ते 2014 दरम्यान विभागीय परिषदा आणि त्यांच्या स्थायी समित्यांच्या एकूण 25 बैठका झाल्या होत्या, तर 2014 पासून विभागीय परिषदा आणि त्यांच्या स्थायी समित्यांच्या एकूण 71 बैठका झाल्या आहेत. बैठकांच्या संख्येत झालेली ही जवळपास तिप्पट वाढ म्हणजे पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांच्या 'टीम इंडिया' संकल्पनेचे एक उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण आहे. या बैठकांमध्ये एकूण 1893 मुद्द्यांवर चर्चा झाली, त्यापैकी 1445 मुद्दे सोडवण्यात आले. हा निकाल या बैठकांची कार्यक्षमता आणि परिणामकारकता दर्शवतो. सायबर गुन्ह्यांना आळा घालण्यासाठी सर्व अर्बन को-ऑपरेटिव्ह बँकांना FCFRS प्रणाली आणि I4C केंद्राशी जोडणे आवश्यक असल्याचे केंद्रीय मंत्री अमित शाह यांनी नमूद केले. तसेच, आगामी काळात किनारपट्टीच्या सुरक्षेला अधिक बळ देण्यासाठी गृह In a recent article in @ThePrintIndia on the risks to India from Brent crude nearing $100 amid the US-Iran conflict, Aashi Gupta, Associate Fellow at ICRIER, weighs in on how much of the shock the economy can absorb. With India importing close to 90% of its crude, she notes the economy could withstand prices in the $90-100 range for several quarters, but a prolonged spike near $100 could feed into core inflation and moderate growth to around 6.5-7%. In the longer term, India must reduce its dependence on imported energy and strengthen export competitiveness to reduce its vulnerability to external shocks. In a recent episode of the @dekodernews, Dr. Ashok Gulati discusses whether India's rapid push to 20% ethanol blending (E20) is quietly being paid for through the grocery bill. Reaching E20 five years ahead of target is a genuine energy-security gain. But, Dr. Gulati notes, blending has raced from around 5% in 2019 to 20% in 2026, far outpacing feedstock supply. With sugar's modal retail price up 44% in a month and pressure now shifting to maize, eggs and poultry, he warns food security cannot be traded off against fuel security. His recommendations include opening up sugar and ethanol imports, keeping policy flexible enough to dial blending back to 15% when feedstock is tight, and giving consumers an E10/E20 choice at the pump, similar to other nations like Brazil. In their recent op-ed in @htTweets, @profarpita1 and Geetika Gupta argue that the government must invest in sustainability standards if India's agri-exports are to keep their footing in the EU and UK markets. Meeting rules like CBAM, the EU Deforestation Regulation and the CSDDD will demand full backward supply-chain traceability to the farm, along with compliance with environmental and labour standards. An ongoing ICRIER survey of plantation crops like tea, coffee and tobacco found that meeting EU and UK requirements could require more than five times the current investment over the next three years. The strain falls hardest on SMEs, whose share in these crops has slipped to around 10%. The authors call for a single government-led traceability system covering both environmental and social audits, backed by smart public investment, stronger private investment and FDI, and 10-15 multi-stakeholder pilot projects to help SME exporters meet European requirements. Imagine paper that holds real flowers and leaves inside its fibers. That's Guizhou's Huacao Paper, a 1,400-year-old craft from Shiqiao Village in Danzhai County. Made from mulberry bark through ancient Tang‑dynasty techniques, artisans embed fresh petals and foliage into wet pulp, then let it dry naturally under the sun. This heritage craft is recognized as a national intangible cultural heritage, and its finest grade, Yingchun Paper, is so durable it can last 1,500 years – which is why it's used to restore ancient texts at the Forbidden City. Today, Huacao Paper has found new life in creative products like lamps, fans and bookmarks, and is being exported to over 40 countries. #LongMarch90 #LongMarchSnap

Fal.Con 2026 closed with incredible keynotes that gave customers a look at what comes next for cybersecurity in the AI era. CrowdStrike Chief AI & Autonomous Systems Officer Bartley Richardson showed how the Cyber Super Intelligence Lab is bringing together frontier AI, world-class threat intelligence, purpose-built harnesses and the Falcon platform to tilt the advantage back to defenders. He also went deeper into CrowdStrike SafeMind and the adversarial co-evolution, where the best offense is built for one reason: to forge a better defense, both moving at the speed of AI. Alex Ionescu, our Chief Technology Innovation Officer, followed with the road ahead for the Falcon sensor. A more resilient, flexible, modular architecture that expands the classes of systems the sensor can run on, and the missions it can take on. AI inference running directly on the endpoint with our first small language model running on the NPU. Fifteen years of engineering, and he showed exactly where it goes next. Together, they made the case that matters most: as AI transforms both offense and defense, security has to evolve with it. We are bringing AI-powered defense closer to where attacks happen, pairing intelligence in the cloud with reasoning on the endpoint to stop threats at machine speed. What a way to close out an unforgettable week at #FalCon2026

Gearing Up to Eliminate Tuberculosis In their latest article ‘Gearing up to eliminate tuberculosis’, Prof. Gobardhan Das, Member, NITI Aayog, and Simarjot Kaur, Consultant, NITI Aayog, highlight India’s significant progress in the fight against tuberculosis and the opportunities to accelerate its elimination. The article highlights improvements in TB diagnosis, treatment and patient support, along with advances in indigenous innovation, including new diagnostics, shorter treatment regimens and research towards vaccines and drug-resistant TB. It also emphasises the growing role of Indian research institutions, pharmaceutical companies, digital health platforms and community-based interventions in strengthening India’s TB response. The authors underline the need for sustained investment in biotechnology, diagnostics, nutrition, sanitation, early diagnosis and affordable healthcare, while leveraging India’s scientific and manufacturing capabilities to move towards a TB-free India. #Tuberculosis #TBNuktBharat @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp @dasgobardhan

Shri Rajiv Gauba delivered the inaugural address at the 5th e-FAST India Summit 2026. During the event, he marked a significant milestone in India’s clean mobility journey with the launch of the Platform for Aggregating Clean Transport (PACT) and the Zero Emission Truck (ZET) Marketplace. In his address, Shri Gauba noted that e-FAST has evolved over four years from a forum for dialogue into a vehicle of coordinated action, mirroring the shift in India's clean mobility discourse from intent to implementation. He emphasized that transitioning to electric mobility is an economic, environmental, and strategic imperative essential for achieving the global commitment of Net Zero by 2070 and realizing the vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047 and improving the quality of living of citizens. He outlined the progress achieved through government initiatives including the PLI schemes for automobiles and advanced chemistry cells, expansion of public charging infrastructure to around 67,500 chargers, and demand-side schemes such as FAME, PM e-DRIVE, PARIVARTAN and PM e-Bus Sewa, supporting a steady rise in EV sales. Addressing the heavy-duty commercial sector, Shri Gauba noted that while heavy trucks represent only 3-4% of the vehicle fleet, they contribute to over a third of transport-sector carbon emissions. He identified structural fragmentation among logistics operators, high financing costs, and the absence of coordinated corridor planning as the key constraints holding back the market, noting that PACT and the ZET Marketplace have been designed to close precisely this gap through demand aggregation, financing innovation and corridor-based projectization. Shri Gauba called upon logistics providers, manufacturers, charge point operators and financiers to engage with the platform in shaping the corridors, financing instruments and commercial models that will define electric freight in India. #eFASTIndia #ElectricFreight #SustainableTransport @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

Chief Minister Smt. Rekha Gupta has ordered strict and comprehensive action following the Satya Niketan incident. She is continuously monitoring the rescue, relief and safety measures. Building owner has been arrested and legal proceedings are underway. Five MCD officials, including Deputy Commissioner, Superintending Engineer, Executive Engineer, Assistant Engineer and Junior Engineer, have been suspended with immediate effect. Buildings with a fifth floor across Delhi have been ordered to be sealed immediately. Nearby PGs and other buildings are also being inspected. Any building found violating safety norms will face immediate sealing action. A policy will be brought to make periodic structural audits and building safety certification mandatory for all buildings used for public activities, including PGs, nursing homes, schools and other institutions. No public activity will be permitted in any such building until its safety is duly certified. Delhi Government is treating the matter with utmost seriousness. There will be no compromise on public safety, and responsibility will be fixed at every level.

5/5 Staged units move to GTRE’s 130 kN Rajanukunte testbed for ~700 hours of endurance runs. Integration at Chitradurga brings taxi trials in 2027–28, paving the way for Ghatak’s KDE-powered maiden flight and military clearance by 2029–30. The prize: sovereign unmanned strike.

4/5 For Ghatak’s low-observable airframe, a deep S-duct serpentine intake removes radar line-of-sight to the fan face. Development also includes a flat 2D exhaust nozzle with IR suppression and fluidic thrust vectoring for low-observable flight control. Next: endurance.

3/5 KDE’s indigenous core: DMRL-developed single-crystal high-pressure turbine blades, MIDHANI nickel superalloys and dual-lane AFADEC. Industry partners include Godrej Aerospace, Azad Engineering and MTAR. But Ghatak demands more than indigenous thrust. It demands stealth.

ރ. އަތޮޅު ވާދޫއާ ބެހޭ ގޮތުން އެ ރަށަށް އުފަން ޒުވާން ލިޔުންތެރިޔާ ޒިދާން އަޙުމަދު ލިޔުއްވާފައިވާ "ވާވެރިންގެ ވާދޫ" ކިޔާލައިފީމެވެ. މި ފޮތުގައި ވާދޫއާ ބެހޭ ގޮތުން މުހިންމު ވަރަށް ގިނަ ވާހަކަތަކެއް އެބަހުއްޓެވެ. ރަށުގައި މީހުން ވަޒަންވެރިވި ގޮތާއި، ދިރިއުޅުމަށް ކުރާ މަސައްކަތާއި، ރަށުގެ އާދަކާދަތަކާއި، ޘަޤާފީ ކަންތައްތައް ހިމެނެއެވެ. ރާއްޖޭގެ ކޮންމެ ރަށަކީ އެ ރަށަކަށް ޚާއްޞަ ކަންތައްތަކެއް ހުންނަ ރަށެކެވެ. ދިރިއުޅުމުގެ ވައްޓަފާޅިއާއި ކެއުންބުއިމަށް ބޭނުންކުރާ ބާވަތްތަކާއި ގޮތްތަކެވެ. މި ފޮތުގައި އެ ގޮތުން ވާދޫއަށް ނިސްބަތްވާ މިފަދަ ކަންތައްތައް ވެސް ޒިދާން ވަނީ ފާހަގަކުރައްވާފައެވެ. މީ ރާއްޖޭގެ ތާރީޚާއި، ޘަޤާފަތާއި، އާދަކާދަ ދިރާސާކުރައްވާ ފަރާތްތަކަށް އަދި ތަޢުލީމީ ދާއިރާއަށް ޒިދާން ހަދިޔާކުރައްވާފައިވާ ވަރަށް މުހިންމު މަސައްކަތެކެވެ. ރާއްޖޭގެ ކޮންމެ ރަށަކާ ބެހޭ ގޮތުން މިފަދަ ދިރާސާއެއް ކޮށްފިނަމަ، މީ ރާއްޖެއަކީ މުއްސަނދި ޘަޤާފަތަކާއި އާދަކާދަތަކެއް ލިބިގެންވާ ޤައުމެއްކަން ފާހަގަކުރެވިގެންދާނެއެވެ. އަޅުގަނޑަށް މި ފޮތް ހަދިޔާކުރެއްވި ކަމަށްޓަކައި ޒިދާނަށް އިޚްލާޞްތެރިކަމާއެކު ޝުކުރު ދަންނަވަމެވެ.

ব্যাট হাতে দীর্ঘদিনের ব্যর্থতার পরও মার্নাস লাবুশেনের ওপর আস্থা রাখল অস্ট্রেলিয়া। দক্ষিণ আফ্রিকার বিপক্ষে তিন ম্যাচের টেস্ট সিরিজের জন্য ঘোষিত ১৬ সদস্যের দলে জায়গা ধরে রেখেছেন এই ব্যাটার। রিকি পন্টিং ও ম্যাথু হেইডেনের মতো সাবেক তারকারা তাকে বাদ দেয়ার পক্ষে মত দিলেও নির্বাচকরা লাবুশেনকে আরও একবার সুযোগ দেয়ার সিদ্ধান্ত নিয়েছেন। ২০২৩ সালের জুলাইয়ের পর টেস্টে আর সেঞ্চুরি পাননি লাবুশেন। সর্বশেষ ৪৩ ইনিংসে তার ব্যাটিং গড় মাত্র ২৪.৬৯। বাংলাদেশের বিপক্ষে তিন ইনিংসে তার রান ছিল ১, ৩১ ও ৪। বাংলাদেশ সিরিজের দল থেকে দক্ষিণ আফ্রিকা সফরের স্কোয়াডে যোগ হয়েছেন কুপার কনলি, মাইকেল নেসার ও ম্যাথু কুনেমান। পায়ের পেশির চোট কাটিয়ে ফিরেছেন নেসার। প্যাট কামিন্স, মিচেল স্টার্ক, জশ হ্যাজেলউড ও স্কট বোলান্ডের সঙ্গে তিনি পঞ্চম পেসার হিসেবে থাকবেন। দলে আছেন অলরাউন্ডার ক্যামেরন গ্রিন ও বিউ ওয়েবস্টার। ওপেনার হিসেবে জায়গা ধরে রেখেছেন ম্যাট রেনশ। দুই দলের তিন ম্যাচের সিরিজ শুরু হবে ৯ অক্টোবর ডারবানে। এরপর ম্যাচ দুটি হবে গকেবেরহা ও কেপটাউনে। অস্ট্রেলিয়ার দল প্যাট কামিন্স (অধিনায়ক), স্কট বোলান্ড, অ্যালেক্স ক্যারি, কুপার কনলি, ক্যামেরন গ্রিন, জশ হ্যাজেলউড, ট্রাভিস হেড, জশ ইংলিস, ম্যাথু কুনেমান, মার্নাস লাবুশেন, নাথান লায়ন, মাইকেল নেসার, ম্যাথু রেনশ, স্টিভ স্মিথ, মিচেল স্টার্ক, বিউ ওয়েবস্টার। #SportsNews #Sports #somoytv

শুরুর ধাক্কা সামলে শেষ পর্যন্ত জয়ের হাসি হাসল আর্সেনাল। এমিরেটস স্টেডিয়ামে রোমাঞ্চকর লন্ডন ডার্বিতে চেলসিকে ২-১ গোলে হারিয়ে প্রিমিয়ার লিগে নিজেদের শতভাগ জয়ের ধারা ধরে রেখেছে চ্যাম্পিয়নরা। ম্যাচের শুরুতেই চমকে দেয় চেলসি। খেলা শুরুর মাত্র ৭৭ সেকেন্ডের মধ্যে ফ্রি কিক থেকে ফিরে আসা বল দুর্দান্ত ভলিতে জালে পাঠান মরগান রজার্স। ডেভিড রায়াকে কোনো সুযোগ না দিয়ে এগিয়ে যায় সফরকারীরা। গোল হজমের পর দ্রুতই নিজেদের গুছিয়ে নেয় আর্সেনাল। একবার তাদের বল জালে গেলেও অফসাইডের কারণে ভিএআরে গোল বাতিল হয়। তবে বেশিক্ষণ অপেক্ষা করতে হয়নি স্বাগতিকদের। কাই হাভার্টজের নিচু শটে ম্যাচে সমতা ফেরে। দ্বিতীয়ার্ধে আক্রমণের ধার আরও বাড়ায় মিকেল আর্তেতার দল। শেষ পর্যন্ত হাভার্টজের চতুর ডামি থেকে তৈরি হওয়া সুযোগ কাজে লাগান মার্টিন ওডেগার্ড। পেনাল্টি স্পটের কাছ থেকে নিখুঁত শটে আর্সেনালকে এগিয়ে দেন অধিনায়ক। শেষ দিকে চেলসি বারবার সমতা ফেরানোর চেষ্টা করলেও আর্সেনালের রক্ষণভাগ ও রায়ার দৃঢ়তায় আর গোল পায়নি তারা। শেষ মুহূর্তে এস্টেভাওয়ের বাঁকানো শট ঠেকিয়ে জয় নিশ্চিত করেন স্প্যানিশ গোলরক্ষক। #football #SportsNews #Sports #somoytv

وزارت تحصیلات عالی طالبان می‌گوید دانشکده‌ی هوافضا با چهار دیپارتمنت در سطح کارشناسی در دانشگاه پولی‌تخنیک کابل ایجاد می‌شود. این وزارت روز یک‌شنبه (۱۵ سنبله) با نشر اعلامیه‌ای، از ایجاد رشته‌ها و دانشکده‌های تازه در دوره‌های کارشناسی، کارشناسی ارشد، دکترا و تخصص پزشکی در دانشگاه‌های دولتی و خصوصی کشور خبر داد. طبق اعلامیه، شورای عالی تحصیلات عالی طالبان ایجاد ۲۸ دانشکده و ۲۹ رشته‌ی جدید در دانشگاه‌های دولتی و خصوصی را تصویب کرده است. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/260518

در دوره‌ی کارشناسی ارشد در دانشگاه یزد ایران، شعری از علامه اقبال لاهوری با مفهوم همین «عصر شدن»، با خط نستعلیق در بورد دانشکده‌ی ما نوشته شده بود که مرا بیشتر به یاد این جمله می‌انداخت: «مثل آیینه مشو محو جمال دیگران از دل و دیده فروشوی خیال دیگران در جهان بال و پر خویش گشودن آموز که پریدن نتوان با پر و بال دیگران» کارشناسی ارشد را با کمی اختلاف رشته، آمار اجتماعی-اقتصادی، آغاز کردم. در کنار این مشکل، تفاوت لهجه، به‌ویژه لهجه یزدی، و تفاوت اصطلاحات علمی در افغانستان و ایران، روزهای دشواری را در آغاز این دوره برایم رقم زد. در آن روزها، به‌طور آشکار تردید استادان را نسبت به خودم در پیش‌برد درس‌ها حس می‌کردم. با آن‌هم، هر روز صبح که دانشگاه می‌رفتم، این شعر اقبال را در بورد می‌خواندم و یک‌بار دیگر در ذهنم تلقین می‌شد که عصر ما عصر شدن است و چیز ناممکنی وجود ندارد. با تمام وجود تلاش کردم، کتاب‌های آماری متفاوت خواندم، ۱۱ واحد با دانشجویان کارشناسی، پیش‌نیاز پاس کردم و به درس‌ها ادامه دادم. در نهایت، رتبه اول شدم و در مراسمی که برای تقدیر از دانشجویان برتر برگزار شده بود، یکی از استادان ما که در روزهای نخست فکر می‌کرد ادامه داده نمی‌توانم، روی استیج تالار به من نزدیک شد و آهسته در گوشم گفت: «همچون نگین می‌درخشی.» این جمله برای این بود که در بین دانشجویان برتر در مقاطع مختلف، فقط من پسر بودم و دیگران همه دختران ایرانی بودند. اکنون که در مسیر نگارش رساله‌ی دکترایم در این دانشگاه هستم، با مطالعه‌ی کتاب‌ها و تجربه‌های افراد موفق و آموختن از فرازوفرودهای زندگی آنان، بیش از پیش به این باور رسیده‌ام که عصر ما عصر «شدن» است، نه صرفا عصر «بودن». بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/260515

Andy Burnham’s summer was the start that any prime minister would want. A relaxed PM — a look I never quite mastered — touring the country and getting maximum bang for his buck from a string of small yet symbolically significant policies. But this autumn will pose a very different challenge. It will be dominated by the budget. Íntegra do Pronunciamento à Nação: 7 de setembro Minhas amigas e meus amigos, amanhã, 7 de setembro, é dia de comemorar a Independência do Brasil. Para além do grito de Dom Pedro I às margens do Rio Ipiranga, a Independência do Brasil foi uma dura conquista de homens e mulheres que deram suas vidas nas batalhas contra a tirania, a escravidão e a injustiça social. De Tiradentes, herói da Inconfidência Mineira, a Maria Quitéria, Maria Felipa e Joana Angélica, heroínas do 2 de julho na Bahia. Defender a Independência do Brasil é defender nossa soberania e nossa democracia. Mais do que nunca, é preciso lutar pelo que é nosso. Temos a segunda maior reserva de terras raras do mundo, e a maior fonte de água doce. No último mês, descobrimos uma nova e rica reserva de petróleo. Nossas riquezas devem servir ao futuro do povo brasileiro. Foi aprovado no Congresso Nacional o marco legal que permitirá ao Brasil transformar as enormes reservas de minerais críticos e terras raras em desenvolvimento e riqueza para o povo brasileiro. Recursos naturais que, da mesma forma que o nosso petróleo, devem ser usados para o desenvolvimento de tecnologia de ponta e geração de empregos de qualidade no Brasil. Por isso, não podemos baixar a cabeça diante de potências estrangeiras que querem transformar o Brasil novamente em colônia. Não somos colônia e não seremos colônia de ninguém. Minhas amigas e meus amigos, um país soberano é aquele capaz de defender seu território, suas fronteiras, seu meio ambiente, suas riquezas e seu povo de quaisquer interesses estrangeiros. Um país soberano é aquele capaz de criar as oportunidades que o seu povo precisa para conquistar a própria independência. A independência financeira, a independência de poder estudar e pensar livremente, escolher a melhor profissão e o melhor emprego. Ter mais tempo para si mesmo e para sua família. A independência de contar, como previsto na Constituição Federal, com saúde pública de qualidade e a melhor educação gratuita para seus filhos. E de viver em um país livre da fome, da pobreza e de todas as formas de desigualdade, com direitos para todos, em vez de privilégios para poucos. Minhas amigas e meus amigos, o Brasil trabalha pela paz mundial e a harmonia entre as nações. Defendemos o livre comércio. Nenhum governante estrangeiro tem o direito de dizer de quem podemos comprar e para quem podemos vender. Somos um país soberano, e nossas decisões pertencem a nós e a mais ninguém. Temos motivos de sobra para nos orgulharmos do nosso país. Temos na Amazônia uma das maiores biodiversidades do planeta. Somos exemplo na defesa do meio ambiente. Nossa riqueza cultural encanta o mundo. Somos referência mundial em transição energética e no enfrentamento da emergência climática que ameaça o futuro da humanidade. E temos cada um e cada uma de vocês, que formam o extraordinário povo brasileiro, um dos mais admirados em todo o planeta. Um feliz Dia da Independência, e que Deus continue abençoando o nosso Brasil.

High blood pressure - or #hypertension - often shows no warning signs, yet it increases the risk for heart disease, stroke, blindness, dementia, and other complications. A simple blood pressure check can be life-saving. Getting your blood pressure measured the right way helps ensure accurate results. Incorrect positions can lead to incorrect readings. ✔ Sit with your back supported ✔ Legs uncrossed and feet flat on the floor ✔ Arm supported with the cuff at heart level ✔ Use correct cuff size ✔ Rest for at least 5 minutes before the reading ✔ Do not talk during or between measurements ✔ Avoid exercise, tea/coffee, and smoking for at least 30 minutes before reading Small steps can make a big difference in protecting your health.

Free market thinkers identified this perverse incentive structure before Johnson signed the Economic Opportunity Act. Every dollar taxed from productive activity carries a deadweight cost before it reaches anyone's dinner table. Capital formation lifts people out of poverty. AI Avenger (@AI__Avenger) Alibaba founder spent 64 free minutes at Moscow State University explaining how to build a $450 billion company from an apartment with 18 people. Almost nobody who bought a business course that year has watched it. Jack Ma promised 700 Moscow State University students 5,000 Russian jobs in October 2017. He had 100 people in Moscow at the time. The second-year physics student who introduced him read the numbers off a card. Company is 18 years old. Founded by 18 people in a Hangzhou apartment. $450 billion market cap. 30 million jobs created directly or indirectly. Ma opened by telling the room he failed the university entrance exam 3 times. He flew 867 hours that year. He said Alibaba makes stupid decisions almost every day and just does it again. Then a student asked about delivery. Ma said he met some Russian girls 2 years earlier and asked how fast AliExpress shipped. They said it was great. He asked what great meant. They said 45 days. "Great is 45 minutes. Not 45 days." He had it down to 15 by 2017. He wanted 72 hours. The part nobody quotes from that hour: he told them he did not want to win. AliExpress was under 1% of Alibaba's business. Russian e-commerce was under 1% of Russian retail, roughly where China sat 12 years earlier. He said he had no interest in Alibaba becoming the largest marketplace in Russia. Build your own logistics. Build your own payments. Build your own Alibaba. "Don't wait for the monopoly. Don't wait for the bank. If everything's ready, why do they need you?" Then he announced a $15 billion research lab, said his CTO was flying in to hire MSU mathematicians and physicists, and wrote a contact address on stage. He admitted he doesn't read email. February 2022. Alibaba stopped funding AliExpress Russia. The venture had about 1,000 staff. More than half were cut. Warehouses shut. By 2024 the rubles stopped clearing. The lab never opened. Ozon and Wildberries took the market he had just described to them. He was right about the 1%. Wrong about who would still be standing there. He told them to build it without him. 5 years later they had to. Video — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/AI__Avenger/status/2096198831649980591#m

The Next Frontier: Space Station, Moon and Planetary Exploration This transition is particularly important in the context of Space Vision 2047. India’s ambitions include establishing the Bharatiya Antariksh Station by 2035, undertaking an Indian crewed mission to the Moon by 2040, developing next-generation and reusable launch systems, pursuing sustained lunar and planetary exploration, and establishing India as a major global space power. These are technologically demanding missions that require ISRO to remain focused on advanced research and capabilities that cannot simply be substituted by commercial activity. The objective is therefore to enable industry to scale mature capabilities while ISRO pushes India towards the next technological frontier. The new institutional architecture gives each part of the space ecosystem a distinct role. The Department of Space provides overall policy direction. ISRO remains the core organisation for advanced R&D, technology development and national missions. IN-SPACe facilitates and authorises the participation of non-government entities, while NSIL undertakes commercialisation and industry-led utilisation of mature capabilities. Industry and start-ups contribute investment, innovation, manufacturing capacity and market access. At the same time, ownership and control of critical national space infrastructure and strategic capabilities will continue to remain with the Government. Private participation in operations and services will be enabled where appropriate and will remain subject to national-security, safety and other regulatory requirements. Strategic and nationally critical capabilities will continue to be governed by security, safety, quality and national-interest considerations. Building India’s Overall Space Capability The emergence of a vibrant private space ecosystem is already one of the major outcomes of 2020 space reforms. From only a handful of Indian space start-ups in 2020, India today has more than 450, working across launch vehicles, satellites, propulsion, ground systems, Earth observation, communications and space applications. This has brought additional investment, entrepreneurial talent and technological innovation while creating opportunities for highly skilled professionals and strengthening India’s overall space capability. India’s space economy is presently estimated at around $8.4 billion, still a relatively small share of the rapidly expanding global space economy. India aims to increase its share of the global space market to $44 billion by 2033. That scale cannot be achieved through government resources and ISRO’s manpower alone. It requires private capital, industrial capacity, entrepreneurship and global market access. A stronger Indian space industry can augment ISRO’s capabilities, strengthen domestic supply chains, attract talent and investment, increase production and competitiveness, and enable India to capture a larger share of the global space economy. A Stronger ISRO at the Centre The success of the reforms should ultimately be measured by the growth of India’s aggregate space capability. ISRO remains at the centre of India’s space programme, leading national efforts in advanced research, strategic capabilities, human space-flight, next-generation launch technologies, the Bharatiya Antariksh Station and lunar and planetary exploration, while a wider Indian ecosystem provides the scale needed to realise India’s Space Vision 2047.

Clarification regarding media reports on concerns relating to Space Sector Reforms and the role of ISRO ISRO’s Next Chapter: Leading India’s National Space Ecosystem There has been considerable reporting in parts of the media around the future role of ISRO including speculations and misinformation that there is an attempt to privatise ISRO or reduce its role. These assertions are completely baseless and incorrect. We wish to categorically state that ISRO will neither be privatised nor will its importance be diminished. ISRO will continue to remain India’s principal institution for advanced space research and technology development, national and strategic missions, space science and exploration, and critical and frontier space capabilities. Participation of private sector in space is not about reducing ISRO’s role. It is about enabling ISRO to focus even more strongly on the next generation of India’s space programme, while industry scales mature technologies and capabilities. What is changing is not the importance of ISRO, but the scale and structure of India’s space ecosystem. Towards an ISRO-Led Space Ecosystem The space-sector reforms initiated since 2020 and institutionalised through the Indian Space Policy 2023, along with progressive liberalisation of FDI policy, aim to create a larger, stronger and globally competitive Indian space ecosystem. Industry, start-ups and academia are being enabled to participate across the space value chain, complementing and multiplying ISRO’s capabilities. The reforms should therefore be seen as ecosystem expansion and capability multiplication, not privatisation. As India’s industrial and technological capabilities have grown, mature and scalable activities can increasingly be undertaken by Indian industry. ISRO has already transferred around multiple technologies to industry. Transferring a mature technology does not mean ISRO is withdrawing from that domain. It enables large-scale production, commercialisation, innovation and access to global markets while allowing ISRO’s scientific and technical manpower to concentrate on advanced research, next-generation technologies and complex national missions. The transition is therefore towards an “ISRO-led national space ecosystem.” ISRO’s Focus Will Move Further Towards Frontier Technologies ISRO’s role will progressively strengthen in areas where its scientific expertise matters most: frontier R&D, advanced technologies, human spaceflight, next-generation launch systems, deep-space and planetary missions and strategic national capabilities. It will continue developing cutting-edge technologies, including advanced payloads for communication, navigation and Earth observation, sensors, propulsion systems and other critical technologies. Meanwhile, mature and routinely manufactured systems can increasingly be scaled through industry. Production of mature launch vehicles, routine satellites and other established systems can increasingly be undertaken by industry or PSUs through appropriate competitive processes. This allows ISRO to devote more resources and scientific manpower to the next generation of technologies and missions, while the wider ecosystem provides the investment, manufacturing capacity and scale required by an expanding national space programme.

I appreciated the opportunity to spend a few days in Berlin this past week meeting with senior officials from across the German government on the Middle East -- and of course Ukraine. A few themes came through clearly: 1) Ukraine is still Berlin's foreign policy priority, but Germany is likely to ratchet up its intensity on the conflict and Russia. Expect Berlin to take an even harder line on Russia now that it's confirmed Moscow was behind last month's drone attacks on Leipzig airport. The focus on Ukraine has been easier to sustain lately given that the conflict with Iran has flared and faded without resulting into a full-blown war as it was in the spring. If a broader war in the Middle East reemerges, it may challenge Berlin's bandwidth to play a meaningful role across both conflicts. 2) Frustration with the US runs deep. The Trump administration's decision to act in Iran without consulting allies is viewed by Berlin with derision. As a result, German leaders have little patience for the idea that it should now help reopen the Strait of Hormuz or fall in line behind Washington's "Economic D-Day demands." Which is a bit ironic given that Germany has been more forward-leaning than the US on sanctioning Iran the last few years. 3) The Middle East matters to Germany, but it isn't the priority. Berlin sees real opportunity with the Gulf states, particularly on trade and defense-tech investment — which is symbiotic for all: GCC countries want to diversify their suppliers, and German manufacturers like Rheinmetall are eager to sell. But over the next year, German attention will tilt even more toward Ukraine and building out common European security, especially as Washington starts to look like a less reliable partner. 4) The likely AfD win in Saxony-Anhalt today has German leaders rattled. There's a real debate about what it means: the start of a broader shift, or a protest vote the mainstream parties can still come back from before it bleeds into future federal elections. But on one point there's wide agreement — comparing the AfD to Italy's Brothers of Italy, UK's Reform, or even France's National Rally is a mistake. The AfD is more radical and less willing to compromise, which is a genuinely frightening prospect to many in the country given how intensely the memory of WWII and the Holocaust still shapes how it sees its role in the world. @AtlanticCouncil @ACMideast

Weekend Ukraine map thread for Sunday 6th September 2026 A focus today on two directions where Russian forces are attempting to make significant advances. South of Dobropillya, Russian forces have been sighted inside the 'other' Dobropillya as per the map, whilst towards Druzhkivka they continue their attempts to push onwards. These are not insignificant movements, and both directions warrant close attention in the weeks ahead. Further towards west Zaporizhia, in the Orikhiv direction, Russian forces continue to be sighted within Orikhiv itself, with no indication yet that Ukrainian forces have succeeded in clearing them. We shall see how this develops. On the long-range front, the Russian arms carrier Lady Mariia, sailing from St Petersburg towards Algeria and, presumably, ultimately Tartus, was struck north of Libya by what appears to have been a Ukrainian drone drop attack. The vessel was damaged multiple times, although it remains unclear whether she is now adrift or has continued upon her voyage. The Lady Mariia is an especially interesting case. Sanctioned by governments across the world, she nevertheless continued to carry military cargo with remarkable freedom over the years - from North Korean matériel entering Russia to weapons deliveries destined for Myanmar and elsewhere. Hell, even bringing arms through the Bosphorus, despite the Montreux Convention. The Sanctions are rather less formidable when nobody actually bothers to enforce them. Meanwhile, further damage from the Adler strikes of 4 September has emerged, including two destroyed helicopters. The Ryazan refinery was also struck. Mid-range strikes continue apace The tragedy, however, is that without sufficient manpower, equipment and the willingness to commit it, this pressure alone will not translate into the liberation of territory. It raises the price. It constrains the occupier. It makes the machinery of war harder to sustain. But it takes someone willing and able to go in there and kick the occupier out, of which Ukraine has precious few, and even less of a drive to increase manpower than last year. Plenty of war left.

Il y a 130 ans, la France faisait naître le cinéma. Aujourd’hui, le cinéma, les séries, l’animation et les jeux vidéo sont bien plus que des industries : ils sont des biens communs qui façonnent nos imaginaires et nous relient par-delà les frontières. Mais jamais ces biens communs n’ont connu de bouleversements aussi profonds. Nous sommes entrés dans une nouvelle révolution de l’image et de la création. L’intelligence artificielle en repousse les frontières. Les plateformes transforment nos usages. Les modèles de financement se réinventent. Nos enfants grandissent dans un flot d’images sans précédent. Face à des défis qui ne connaissent pas de frontières, aucune nation ne peut agir seule. C’est pourquoi, à Saint-Paul-de-Vence, la France et la Corée du Sud, deux grandes nations de création attachées à la diversité culturelle et à leur souveraineté, réunissent ceux qui créent, produisent, financent, diffusent, innovent et décident. Notre ambition : forger de nouvelles alliances entre créateurs et technologies, acteurs publics et privés, cinéma, télévision, plateformes et jeux vidéo. Pour que cette révolution ouvre de nouveaux possibles sans uniformiser nos imaginaires. Créer. Protéger ceux qui créent. Faire circuler les œuvres et les idées. Donner aux nouvelles générations les clés pour comprendre et inventer. Préserver, enfin, le pouvoir le plus précieux de la création : nous ouvrir au monde et nous rassembler. C’est l’ambition du Sommet Lumière que je co-présiderai demain avec mon homologue coréen à Saint-Paul-de-Vence. Action.

The Nazification of the so‑called “pro-Palestine” movement is no exaggeration. Large segments of this conglomerate have turned what should be a moral cause into an exceptionally hateful, racist, antisemitic, homophobic, and toxic ecosystem of low‑information activists, journalists, academics, and online personalities. Since my New York Times opinion piece, “To Save Gaza, Resist Hamas,” I have been targeted by a global smear campaign driven by Hamas, “pro-Palestine” fascists, antisemites, racists, and deeply disturbed individuals with hundreds of thousands of followers. They have circulated AI‑generated images and fabricated posts claiming I am Jewish, an Epstein‑connected agent blackmailed by Mossad, a closeted gay man, and a paid influencer funded by Israel (I am none of those things, in case you are curious). This is happening at the same moment other corners of the “pro-Palestine” industrial complex are calling a Black member of Congress a “monkey” and a “boy.” Add to that the meltdown among supposed journalists, academics, and influencers who clearly did not read the op‑ed and reacted only to the title, furious that I criticized Hamas, their favorite “resistance” Islamist fascist group in Gaza, or that I refused to place all blame for the coastal enclave’s problems on Israel. The backlash actually proves my central argument in this piece. Many in the “pro-Palestine” industrial complex refuse to engage with complexity around Gaza, Hamas, and Palestinian agency and responsibility, even within the reality of Israel’s overwhelming power advantage. By personalizing their reactions and resorting to insults instead of substance, including my explicit critique of Israeli policies, they are doing exactly what I argue must change. Palestinians and their allies can criticize Israel as much as they want, but fantasies about Israel’s destruction are neither moral nor pragmatic. Most critically, no one holds a monopoly on what counts as a legitimate Palestinian viewpoint. Palestinians are diverse, their opinions are deeply fragmented, and many in Gaza are furious with Hamas’s narratives and actions, a reality ignored by externally based Palestinians and non-Palestinians in the “pro-Palestine” industrial complex. It is time to delegitimize, call out, resist, and dismantle the current “pro-Palestine” movement and build an entirely new apparatus that rejects the hateful, bigoted, racist, homophobic, Jihadi, violent, and antisemitic voices that have become mainstream within this failed environment.

The ripple effects of Pak-Afghan trade collapse are far-reaching In their latest piece, Dr Farah Naz and Dr Anjeela Khurram examine the far-reaching economic and security consequences of the Pak–Afghan trade collapse. Border closures are not just disrupting trade—they are spoiling food, hurting farmers and traders, fuelling price volatility, threatening food security, and weakening Pakistan’s position as a regional trade hub. The authors argue for protected “green channels” for perishable goods, alternative trade routes, stronger cold-chain infrastructure, and mechanisms to separate essential trade from political tensions. Security and economic continuity must go hand in hand. প্যারিসের উপকণ্ঠে ওভেরভিলিয়ে শহরে বিস্ফোরণে একটি বাড়ি ধসে এক বাংলাদেশি পরিবারের তিন বছর বয়সি এক শিশুর মৃত্যু হয়েছে। এ ঘটনায় আরও সাতজন আহত হয়েছেন, যাদের মধ্যে দুজনের অবস্থা সংকটাপন্ন। শনিবার স্থানীয় সময় রাত সাড়ে ৯টার দিকে সেইন-সাঁ-দনি বিভাগের ওভেরভিলিয়ে শহরের রু পল-ভেরলেন এলাকায় একটি প্যাভিলিয়ন বাড়িতে এ বিস্ফোরণ ঘটে। এতে বাড়িটির একটি অংশ ধসে পড়ে। স্থানীয় কর্তৃপক্ষের বরাতে ফরাসি সংবাদমাধ্যম লো মোঁদ ও লে প্যারিজিয়াঁ লিখেছে, গ্যাস লিক থেকে বিস্ফোরণটি ঘটে থাকতে পারে বলে প্রাথমিকভাবে ধারণা করা হচ্ছে। এ ঘটনায় ববিনি প্রসিকিউটর অফিসের অধীনে একটি তদন্ত শুরু হয়েছে। জানা যায়, নিহত শিশুটির নাম নাহিল। সে হবিগঞ্জের বানিয়াচং উপজেলার পুকড়া ইউনিয়নের কাটখাল গ্রামের বাসিন্দা ফ্রান্সপ্রবাসী রাসেল আহমদের ছেলে।

আজ (৬ সেপ্টেম্বর) সংগীতশিল্পী রাজা বশিরের জন্মদিন। বাবা-মা প্রখ্যাত সঙ্গীতশিল্পী দম্পতি বশির আহমেদ ও মীনা বশিরের দেখানো পথেই হাঁটছেন এই শিল্পী। জন্মদিন উপলক্ষে শ্রোতাদের বিশেষ উপহার দিলেন তিনি। নিজের মিউজিক্যাল প্রজেক্ট ‘রাগা জংশন’-এর দ্বিতীয় গান ‘চুপিচুপি’ প্রকাশ করেছেন সারগাম সাউন্ড স্টেশনের ইউটিউব চ্যানেলে। শহিদুল আলম তিতুর লেখা গানটির সুর করেছেন রাজা বশির, আর গেয়েছেন পণ্ডিত তুষার দত্ত। রাজা বশির জানিয়েছেন, ‘চুপিচুপি’ শুধু একটি নতুন গান নয়, বাবা-মায়ের সংগীত ঐতিহ্য, নিজের সুরসাধনা এবং গুণী শিল্পীদের সঙ্গে কাজ করার এক দারুণ অভিজ্ঞতা। ‘রাগা জংশন’-এর প্রথম গান হিসেবে প্রকাশিত সঙ্গীতশিল্পী হোমায়েরা বশিরের ‘মেঘ’ দর্শকের মাঝে ইতিবাচক সাড়া ফেলেছে। #entertainmentnews #news #Bangladesh #somoytv

হিল ডিকিনসন স্টেডিয়ামে মঞ্চস্থ হলো টানটান রোমাঞ্চে ঠাঁসা নাটক। ম্যানচেস্টার ইউনাইটেডের বিপক্ষে দুইবার পিছিয়ে পড়ে ঘরের মাঠে হারের শঙ্কায় ছিল এভারটন। কিন্তু যোগ করা সময়ের যখন আর মাত্র কয়েক সেকেন্ড বাকি, সব আলো কেড়ে নিলেন আইন্সলি মেটল্যান্ড-নাইলস। চমৎকার এক গোলে মূল্যবান একটি পয়েন্ট এনে দিলেন এভারটনকে। রোববার (৬ সেপ্টেম্বর) ঘরের মাঠে ম্যানচেস্টার ইউনাইটেডের সঙ্গে ২-২ গোলে ড্র করেছে এভারটন। দ্বিতীয়ার্ধে দুইবার লিড নিয়েও জয় নিয়ে মাঠ ছাড়তে পারেনি মাইকেল ক্যারিকের দল। গোলশূন্য প্রথমার্ধের পর দ্বিতীয়ার্ধের ২ মিনিটের মাথায় ম্যানচেস্টার ইউনাইটেডকে এগিয়ে দেন ব্রায়ান এমবেউমো। কিন্তু ৮৩ মিনিটে টফিদের সমতায় ফেরান টাইরিক জর্জ। ৮৮ মিনিটে বেনজামিন সেসকো গোল করলে ম্যানচেস্টার ইউনাইটেডের জয় নিশ্চিতই মনে হচ্ছিল। কিন্তু নাটকীয়তার তখনো বাকি। ৯৬ মিনিটে মেটল্যান্ড-নাইলস ইউনাইটেডের জালে বল পাঠিয়ে নিশ্চিত জয় কেড়ে নেন। এই ড্রয়ে ৩ ম্যাচে ৫ পয়েন্ট নিয়ে ৮ নম্বরে জায়গা করে নিল এভারটন। সমান ম্যাচে ৪ পয়েন্ট নিয়ে ১১ নম্বরে ইউনাইটেড। #football #SportsNews #Sports #somoytv

How long is a second? It’s 9,192,631,770 cycles of caesium radiation, according to today’s International Standards, which are based on Louis Essen’s atomic clock! Born #onthisday in 1908, Essen, in collaboration with scientist Jack Parry, designed and built the world’s first accurate caesium atomic clock in 1955. It used conventional quartz crystal oscillators, which made it highly accurate compared to the first generation atomic clock that was based on an ammonia maser device. The new clock will only lose around one second over the course of 300 years. Twelve years after Essen and Parry’s new clock was built, it became the basis for the internationally agreed definition of a second, shifting the standard from astronomical time to atomic time. And this is how a second is still defined today.

Before sentencing Omar al-Mukhtar to death, the Italian judge asked him: — Did you fight against the Italian state? Omar al-Mukhtar: Yes. — Did you encourage people to fight against the Italian state? Omar al-Mukhtar: Yes. — How many years did you fight against Italy? Omar al-Mukhtar: About 20 years. — Do you regret what you did? Omar al-Mukhtar: No. — Do you know that you will be executed? Omar al-Mukhtar: Yes. Surprised, the judge said: — It is very sad for a man like you to meet such an end… Omar al-Mukhtar replied: — On the contrary! This is the most beautiful way for my life to end. The judge then offered to acquit him and send him into exile if he wrote a declaration ordering the resistance fighters to end their struggle. Omar al-Mukhtar responded with his famous words: “These fingers, which testify in every prayer that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad (peace be upon him) is His Messenger, can never write anything false! We do not surrender: we either win or die. Even if we die, we win, while you lose. The bitter truth is that you will understand this only when you die—and by then, it will be of no use to you!”
